highlights.excerpt: I can confidently say that humans were not very good at writing secure infrastructure. The endstate will be hypersecure infrastructure and software for all, but we're going to go through some turbulence before we reach that.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我可以很有把握地说：人类并不擅长写安全的基础设施。终态会是人人可用的超安全基础设施与软件，但到达之前我们还会经历一些动荡。
highlights.name: Tibo
highlights.text_zh: Tibo：人类不擅长写安全基础设施，终态将是人人可用的超安全软件

highlights.excerpt: Memory is what allows Claude to learn from experience. In a new Engineering Blog post, we share how “dreaming” helps Claude organize what it’s learned, correct its mistakes, and find what it needs more easily the next time.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 记忆让 Claude 能从经验中学习。在新的工程博客中，我们介绍「做梦」如何帮助 Claude 整理所学、纠正错误，并在下次更容易找到所需信息。
highlights.name: Anthropic
highlights.text_zh: Anthropic：用「做梦」整理 Claude 记忆，纠正错误并更快检索

highlights.excerpt:
A new way to measure how AI agents handle the routine analyses of wet-lab science—BioBasicsBench.

Developed with Ligo, a biotech company focused on enzyme design, the benchmark draws on 100 tasks from real experiments to test whether agents can interpret raw lab data, identify errors, and recognize when the evidence…
highlights.excerpt_zh:
衡量 AI 智能体处理湿实验日常分析的新方式——BioBasicsBench。

与专注酶设计的生物技术公司 Ligo 合作开发，该基准基于真实实验的 100 项任务，测试智能体能否解读原始实验数据、识别错误，并判断证据何时不足以支持结论。
highlights.name: OpenAI
highlights.text_zh: OpenAI 发布 BioBasicsBench：100 项湿实验任务测 AI 智能体

highlights.excerpt:

That Linode VPS called Tommy is where everything started for me, I knew to build startups I needed a server so I just made one and SSH'd into it
highlights.excerpt_zh:
几个月前我也这么做了

关掉了用了 13 年、每月 $300 的 Linode VPS，它托管了我 100 多个站点超过十年！

那台叫 Tommy 的 Linode 是一切的起点——我知道做创业需要服务器，于是就建了一台然后 SSH 进去。
highlights.name: @levelsio
highlights.text_zh: levelsio：关掉用了 13 年、托管 100+ 站点的 $300/月 Linode

highlights.excerpt:
uhh so this is how i found out that i'm not only no longer a Sequoia Scout, my main partner (and boardmember since @Temporalio) is also gone.

no email from sequoia yet about anything in the past month. no response to my texts from any partner. …
highlights.excerpt_zh:
呃，我就这样发现自己不再是 Sequoia Scout，连我的主要合伙人（也是 @Temporalio 董事会成员）也走了。

过去一个月 Sequoia 没有任何邮件，合伙人对我的短信也没回复。

我当初离开上一段合伙关系加入 Sequoia，是因为尊重他们所建立的，觉得那代表硅谷长期伙伴关系的极致，想从内部靠近，而不是只在 @colossusmag 的传记里读到。

很失望。我尊重新方向，但附带伤害很大。

好的一面是，我想我当 Scout 到头了。@mariadlzollo 和我将募集一只小型附属基金，由创始人服务创始人。
highlights.name: swyx
highlights.text_zh: swyx：发现已非 Sequoia Scout，拟与合伙人自建小型基金

highlights.excerpt:
We’re sharing new research demonstrating how AI agents can accelerate the science of stress-testing encryption.

Guided by humans, our models uncovered two major weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA cryptosystems.

Our VP Science @Pushmeet explains more ↓
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我们分享新研究：展示 AI 智能体如何加速加密压力测试科学。

在人类引导下，我们的模型发现了旧版 1024 位 RSA 密码系统的两大弱点。

科学副总裁 @Pushmeet 有更多说明 ↓
highlights.name: Google DeepMind
highlights.text_zh: DeepMind：AI 智能体助攻压力测试加密，发现旧版 1024 位 RSA 两大弱点
